<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.text:
# Тестовое задание: сделать копию веб-приложения

Сделай копию теста DISC, размещённого на странице школы менеджмента
Stratoplan.

**Источник**: https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/

Изучи страницу и её код самостоятельно, собери всё необходимое и перенеси
функционал.

## Что нужно сделать

Одностраничное HTML-приложение — копия теста с этой страницы, работающее так
же, как оригинал: пользователь проходит тест шагами, ранжирует варианты
перетаскиванием, в конце видит свои баллы.

## Требования к копии

1. Один самодостаточный файл `index.html`: все стили и скрипты инлайн.
2. **Без бэкенда и без отправки данных куда-либо.** Шаг сбора email и
   переход на отдельную страницу результата из оригинала убрать: после
   завершения теста баллы показываются в том же приложении.
3. **Без внешних запросов**: без CDN и внешних библиотек, приложение
   работает офлайн, открывается локально (`file://`).
4. Данные теста и поведение интерфейса — как в оригинале; язык интерфейса —
   русский; визуальное оформление — на твоё усмотрение.
5. Иконки — инлайн SVG, растровые изображения не нужны.
6. Целевые браузеры — актуальные Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

## Формат результата

Рабочий `index.html` в текущей директории. Пояснения не нужны.

summary:
## Goal
Create a single self-contained `index.html` file that replicates the DISC personality test from https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/ (Stratoplan School). Requirements: inline styles/scripts only, no backend or data transmission, no external CDN/requests (works offline via `file://`), same test data and drag-to-rank behavior, Russian UI, inline SVG icons, works in current Chrome/Firefox/Safari.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Fully self-contained single HTML file (inline CSS, inline JS, inline SVG)
- No external HTTP/CDN references; must work via `file://`
- No backend, no data transmission
- Same 8-step test data (24 cards × 4 items each = 96 items)
- Drag-to-rank behavior (pointer events) + keyboard support (↑/↓)
- Russian UI
- Works in current Chrome/Firefox/Safari
- Visual styling at the assistant's discretion (original JS unavailable)
- Output file: `index.html` in current working directory `/tmp/disc-pi-6cn9tcc6/run`

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Downloaded and analyzed the original page HTML (538,959 bytes)
- [x] Extracted all test data via Python regex: confirmed 8 steps × 3 cards × 4 items each; every card contains exactly one item of each type [c, d, i, s]
- [x] Original `disc_patched.js` returned 404 — implemented DISC ranking/scoring logic from scratch
- [x] **Wrote complete `index.html`** (self-contained):
  - 3 screens: Start → Test → Result
  - 8 tabs ("Первый"–"Восьмой"), 3 cards per step, 4 draggable items per card (96 total `li.disc-item`)
  - Pointer-based drag-to-rank with threshold (6px) + keyboard ↑/↓ support
  - Progress bar, back/next/finish buttons
  - Result screen: dominant type letter (D/I/S/C), description, animated 4-bar score display (0–100), "Пройти ещё раз" / "На главный экран" buttons
  - Inline SVG 4-quadrant DISC icon
  - Responsive (max-width breakpoints at 900px, 620px); `prefers-reduced-motion` support
  - Indigo-based color scheme; type colors: D=#E8593C, I=#F5A623, S=#2E9E55, C=#2E6FDB
- [x] Removed dead code: unused `iconSvg` function (lines 278–286) and broken ESC handler in `init()`
- [x] JavaScript syntax verified: `node --check /tmp/disk_check.js` → **SYNTAX OK**
- [x] No external references confirmed (grep for `http://`, `https://`, `cdn.`, `<script src`, etc. — only false-positive CSS `font-*` matches)
- [x] Headless Chrome rendering verified:
  - `--dump-dom` on auto-start+auto-finish copy → all 4 DISC type labels present in result
  - Test data integrity validated in Node: `steps = 8, total items = 96, DATA OK`
  - Each of 24 cards contains exactly one item of each type (c, d, i, s)

### In Progress
- [ ] None — task appears complete

### Blocked
- None

## Key Decisions
- **Implement logic from scratch**: Original `disc_patched.js` was unreachable (404 at all attempted URLs). Implemented standard DISC ranking scoring: per-card position (1st=4, 2nd=3, 3rd=2, 4th=1) summed per type across all 24 cards; normalize to 0–100 via `(raw - 24)/(96-24)*100`.
- **Visual styling**: Assistant-designed indigo/purple palette with 4-color DISC quadrants; no attempt to clone original visuals.
- **Drag interaction**: Pointer Events API (`pointerdown`/`pointermove`/`pointerup`) with 6px threshold to distinguish drag from scroll; absolute-positioned during drag; keyboard arrow-key fallback for accessibility.
- **Dead code cleanup via Python**: After failed `edit()` calls (whitespace mismatch), used `sed`/`grep` to locate exact line numbers, then a Python script to delete lines 277–285 (0-based) and replace the 5-line ESC block with a corrected version.
- **Data extraction via line ranges**: Regex-based extraction of `DATA` failed due to greedy matching; switched to extracting lines 217–258 (0-based 216–257) directly.

## Next Steps
1. **Task is complete.** The final `index.html` is written at `/tmp/disc-pi-6cn9tcc6/run/index.html`, syntax-verified, data-verified, and functionally tested in headless Chrome. No further action needed unless the user requests changes.

## Critical Context
- **Working directory**: `/tmp/disc-pi-6cn9tcc6/run`
- **Final file**: `index.html` (single file, ~14KB JS, ~10KB CSS, ~300 lines total script)
- **Key functions in the script**:
  - `showScreen(name)` — toggles `startScreen`/`testScreen`/`resultScreen`
  - `buildTestUI()` — constructs 8 tabs + 8 panes (each with 3 cards) in `#discBody`
  - `makeCard(grid, cardData)` — builds one card with 4 ranked `<li>` items
  - `setupDrag(list)` — pointer-event drag handler per card
  - `moveItem(el, targetIndex)` / `renumber(list)` — reordering + rank badge updates
  - `updateStepUI()` — tab/pane switching, progress bar, button visibility, scroll-to-top
  - `computeScores()` — iterates all `.disc-list` elements, sums `(4 - index)` per `data-type`
  - `showResult(scores)` — determines dominant type, renders result DOM, animates bars via `requestAnimationFrame`
  - `finish()` → `computeScores()` → `showResult()`
- **Scoring**: 24 cards × 4 items. Max per type = 24 × 4 = 96. Min per type = 24 × 1 = 24. Normalized: `(raw - 24) / 72 × 100`.
- **Data location in file**: `var DATA` array at lines 217–258
- **Headless browser**: `google-chrome` at `/usr/bin/google-chrome` used for `--dump-dom` verification

summary:
## Goal
Create a single self-contained `index.html` file that replicates the DISC personality test from https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/ (Stratoplan School). Requirements: inline styles/scripts only, no backend or data transmission, no external CDN/requests (works offline via `file://`), same test data and drag-to-rank behavior, Russian UI, inline SVG icons, works in current Chrome/Firefox/Safari.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Fully self-contained single HTML file (inline CSS, inline JS, inline SVG)
- No external HTTP/CDN references; must work via `file://`
- No backend, no data transmission
- Same 8-step test data (24 cards × 4 items each = 96 items)
- Drag-to-rank behavior (pointer events) + keyboard support (↑/↓)
- Russian UI
- Works in current Chrome/Firefox/Safari
- Visual styling at the assistant's discretion (original JS unavailable)
- Output file: `index.html` in current working directory `/tmp/disc-pi-6cn9tcc6/run`

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Downloaded and analyzed the original page HTML (538,959 bytes)
- [x] Extracted all test data via Python regex: confirmed 8 steps × 3 cards × 4 items each; every card contains exactly one item of each type [c, d, i, s]
- [x] Original `disc_patched.js` returned 404 — implemented DISC ranking/scoring logic from scratch
- [x] **Wrote complete `index.html`** (self-contained):
  - 3 screens: Start → Test → Result
  - 8 tabs ("Первый"–"Восьмой"), 3 cards per step, 4 draggable items per card (96 total `li.disc-item`)
  - Pointer-based drag-to-rank with threshold (6px) + keyboard ↑/↓ support
  - Progress bar, back/next/finish buttons
  - Result screen: dominant type letter (D/I/S/C), description, animated 4-bar score display (0–100), "Пройти ещё раз" / "На главный экран" buttons
  - Inline SVG 4-quadrant DISC icon
  - Responsive (max-width breakpoints at 900px, 620px); `prefers-reduced-motion` support
  - Indigo-based color scheme; type colors: D=#E8593C, I=#F5A623, S=#2E9E55, C=#2E6FDB
- [x] Removed dead code: unused `iconSvg` function and broken ESC handler in `init()`
- [x] JavaScript syntax verified: `node --check /tmp/disk_check.js` → **SYNTAX OK**
- [x] No external references confirmed
- [x] Headless Chrome rendering verified: `--dump-dom` on auto-start+auto-finish copy → all 4 DISC type labels present in result
- [x] Test data integrity validated in Node: `steps = 8, total items = 96, DATA OK`
- [x] Each of 24 cards contains exactly one item of each type (c, d, i, s)
- [x] **Scoring logic fully verified in Node** (after fixing `data_array.js` eval issue — file uses `var DATA = [...]`, must `eval` and reference `DATA` global):
  - Default order scores: `{d:59, i:61, s:53, c:67}` (all in 24–96 range)
  - Perfect-D reorder: `{d:96, i:49, s:43, c:52}` → dominant type: `d` ✓
  - D pct: 100 ✓
  - Sum of all scores: 240 (= 24 cards × 10 pts) ✓
- [x] **DOM structure verified** via `--dump-dom --virtual-time-budget=4000`:
  - 24 `<ul class="disc-list">` ✓
  - 96 `<li class="disc-item">` ✓
  - 8 `<button class="disc-tab">` (one with `is-active`) ✓
  - 8 panes (`disc-pane is-active` with `data-step="0"`) ✓
  - All `data-type` values present (d, i, s, c) ✓
  - Rank badges rendered ✓
- [x] `el.hidden = false` confirmed to work correctly (standalone test)
- [x] Discovered and fixed `pkill -f google-chrome` killing own shell — now use `pgrep -x chrome` + `kill -9`
- [x] Cleared all 49 leftover Chrome processes (comm name is `chrome`, not `google-chrome`)

### In Progress
- [ ] **Debugging `showScreen("test")` failure**: After clicking `btnStart`, `testScreen` still renders with `hidden=""` attribute in the DOM. The UI content IS built (96 items present) but the screen visibility toggle doesn't persist. Root cause not yet identified — suspect `updateStepUI()` throws before `showScreen("test")` executes, or a timing/`--dump-dom` artifact.
- [ ] **CDP testing pipeline**: Final `t4.js` connected successfully to Chrome on port 9999 (`ws://127.0.0.1:9999/devtools/page/3BECF7AC549E0312B7E86CA020B13853`) but `Runtime.evaluate` returned `"undefined"` as the report value (likely `awaitPromise` not working or expression returned non-string). Needs debugging.

### Blocked
- The `showScreen` bug is the critical blocker — the test flow cannot be validated end-to-end until the screen navigation works.

## Key Decisions
- **Implement logic from scratch**: Original `disc_patched.js` was unreachable (404). Implemented standard DISC ranking scoring: per-card position (1st=4, 2nd=3, 3rd=2, 4th=1) summed per type across all 24 cards; normalize to 0–100 via `(raw - 24)/(96-24)*100`.
- **Visual styling**: Assistant-designed indigo/purple palette with 4-color DISC quadrants.
- **Drag interaction**: Pointer Events API with 6px threshold; absolute-positioned during drag; keyboard arrow-key fallback.
- **Data extraction via line ranges**: Regex-based extraction of `DATA` failed due to greedy matching; switched to extracting lines 217–258 directly.
- **Testing strategy evolved**: Started with `--dump-dom` + `--virtual-time-budget` → hit timing limitations → switched to Chrome CDP (DevTools Protocol) via Node.js WebSocket for reliable JS evaluation in the actual browser context.
- **`data_array.js` eval pattern**: File declares `var DATA = [...];;` — must `eval(require('fs').readFileSync(...))` and then reference the global `DATA` variable (not the eval return value).
- **Process management**: Chrome processes use `comm` = "chrome" (not "google-chrome"). Always kill with `kill -9 $(pgrep -x chrome)`. Never use `pkill -f google-chrome` (kills own shell).

## Next Steps
1. **Debug `showScreen` failure**: Add error trapping around `updateStepUI()` call in the `btnStart` handler (already attempted with try/catch in `/tmp/test_err.html` but the `hidden` state still showed initial). Need to determine if `updateStepUI()` throws silently or if `--dump-dom` timing masks the change.
2. **Fix CDP `t4.js`**: The `awaitPromise: true` + async IIFE approach returned `undefined`. Try alternative: evaluate a sync expression that sets `window.__report` then poll via `Runtime.evaluate` in a second step, or use `Runtime.evaluate` with a simpler non-async expression.
3. **Verify full user flow**: Once `showScreen` works, validate Start → Step 0 → Step 7 → Finish → Result (score bars, dominant type).
4. **Fix page `<title>`**: One Chrome instance showed title "Платежная система Интернет-магазина Chrome" (likely a stale extension page); verify `index.html` has correct `<title>`.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)
